verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's own docs say it offers OpenFeature Providers, and the docs homepage lists "OpenFeature Compatibility". Its GitHub README states that the OpenFeature partnership means users are "never locked into one vendor", which matches the story's goal of keeping flag code off a single vendor's SDK API. missing for 10: the actual list of supported provider languages (the quoted docs line is truncated), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the providers work.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API

citations.quote: We currently offer [OpenFeature Providers](https://docs.openfeature.dev/docs/reference/concepts/provider) for the following languages:
OpenFeature Compatibility: Use Flagsmith with OpenFeature
Thanks to our partnership with OpenFeature, you are never locked into one vendor.
